title: Frustrated customer, routine case
message: This is ridiculous. ORD-5501 shows delivered but I am not sure the tracking is right. Sort it out.
assistant_text:
**CASE FACTS**
- Customer: C-1001 (Mei Lin Tan)
- Order: ORD-5501, ceramic table lamp, $120.00
- Status: delivered, shipped
- Placed: 2026-10-01; ETA: 2026-10-06
- Charges: 1
- Damage photo on file: yes

I'm sorry about the frustration, Mei Lin. Our record shows ORD-5501 as delivered. It only shows the 6 October ETA, not a confirmed delivery date or carrier tracking details, so I can't independently confirm the tracking from here.

To sort this out, please tell me which applies:
- **The lamp never arrived:** I'll pass this to a specialist to investigate the delivery.
- **The lamp arrived damaged:** we have a damage photo on file, so confirm this and I'll refund the $120 right away.
- **The lamp arrived fine:** there's nothing to fix, and the record is correct.
